title: Unit Event — Tying Tomorrow's Ribbon

meta.Outline: Things have calmed down for N25 since Mafuyu's return to living with Kanade. Meanwhile, Mizuki's sister is back in Japan, and the two have much to talk about. After hearing how she first found her dream in life, Mizuki in turn begins to think about the future.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, yeah, this demo's super good!
It really stabs at your heart, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It does. But you also feel a sense of empathy at the end. A sort of kindness...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, that's good to hear.
In that case, I'll keep working along these lines.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to make the video for this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, what are the lyrics and illustrations gonna be like?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I won't know until I write them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Based on the feel of the demo, probably something that expresses loneliness... But at the end, you realize there was a warmth by your side all along.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I think I sorta have an idea of what to draw.
Imagine a girl in a dimly lit world who always has her head down...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: When she lifts her head at the end, she realizes the moon has been shining down on her. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's really good!
Now I really can't wait to work on it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
All thanks to your song, Kanade♪
I'll start storyboarding the second I get your sketches.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, Mafuyu, let me know when your lyrics are ready♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, let's get back to work.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Those sketches aren't gonna come in for a little while, so I'll look for some useful-looking assets in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm glad Mafuyu seems to be feeling a little better.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was pretty shocked when I heard she'd gone back to Kanade's house...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She must have had a pretty rough time.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She was so resolved to work things out with her mom, and it didn't go to plan...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At the very least, she seems to be able to relax a little whenever she's working on N25 stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There isn't much that I can do for her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I wanna help her take her mind off of what happened by making things feel as normal as possible.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My shift doesn't start until later this evening, right? That means I can sleep in for a bit longer...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, did you just wake up?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I was actually about to go back to sleep.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Getting a good night's sleep is fine and all, but you should make sure you eat meals properly too, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Anyway, what's up? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. I have some good news for you. I just heard from your sister...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line: And she said she's coming to Japan for work!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line: Apparently, the company where your sister works is going to be running a pop-up store in Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line: Not only that, Yuki's going to be serving customers in order to see their reactions and whatnot firsthand.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Does that mean she's gonna be here for a while?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line: That's right. It sounds like it'll take time to set everything up, so she'll be able to stay for a while.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Woohoo! There are so many shops that I wanna check out with her! I'll invite her right away♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. She also wanted to know when you're free, so I'm sure she'll contact you soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, I need to get to work...
There's some keema curry in the kitchen. Make sure to heat it up before you have it, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Good luck at work, mom.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And she's gonna be running a pop-up store in Shibuya... I absolutely have to go♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I got to introduce Kanade and Mafuyu to her that other time, but not Ena...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (To be fair, we were pretty short on time...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But this seems like a good chance to introduce all of N25 to her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll try inviting the others if we can make the timing work out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It feels like it's been forever since I last came to school...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They said it was fine if I got here around lunch, but I'm still super sleepy...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I stayed up so late researching shops that Sis and I can check out together.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We managed to inventory quite a lot of the books we have in storage today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, if we can keep this pace up, we should be able to finish sometime this month.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's Kusanagi and Toya!
Hey, you two!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hiya. Wrapping up some committee work?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, we were both on duty today.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's been a while, Akiyama.
I'm glad to see you look well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You too, Toya!
I heard that you just got back from the States... Yeah, it really does feel like it's been forever!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, how was your trip?
You went to a big music event, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, artists from around the world performed... And we were completely blown away.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we also know what we want to see now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Our goal is to stand on top of the world.
However, until now, we didn't have a concrete idea of what that meant.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But seeing all those incredible performances, and tens of thousands of people burning with the heat, we felt it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is what it means to stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I also really wanna set out into the world, but I still don't have what it takes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? But you're already an amazing singer, Kusanagi. You're as good as some pros out there.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, I still have a lot of work left to do.
We've been training with different troupes lately, and I keep finding new things to work on each time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're training at ArcLand right now, and they perform at such a high level. I've been spending all of my energy just trying to keep up with them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've heard they put on some of the best shows in the country. And you've been training with them, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, Emu's brothers helped us get a few spots in their workshop.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, I can't imagine what that workshop is like. I bet it's chock full of amazing people.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is. The teachers are all world famous, and it has been pretty overwhelming...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But I want to learn as much as I can.
I want to take this experience and use it to make my dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It sounds like you're making good progress toward your goal, Kusanagi. We may be traveling different roads, but let's both keep doing our best.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You two are so dazzling.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You both have such clear dreams and goals that you're working towards!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And you both practically sparkle when you're talking about your dreams♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Do your best, you two! I'll be rooting for you both!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That was fast.
We should start heading back to our classrooms.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I brought back a souvenir from the United States for you, Akiyama. I'll give it to you later. I hope you like it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You got me a souvenir?! Awesome!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks, Toya!
I can't wait to see what it is♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I took those quizzes like I was told, so I should be free for a while.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Plus, I got to see An and Li'l Bro for the first time in forever after school. So, I'm glad that I decided to go today.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Dinner isn't for a little bit, so I think I'll work on some stuff until then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll take another look at the sketch Ena sent me yesterday, and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, Enanan, what's up?
I didn't realize you were working.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, Amia, hey.
I had some free time after art class got out, so I decided to draw up more of those sketches.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Heh heh heh.
Guess what? I went to school today! Aren't I a good student♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hardly... You went after lunch or something like you always do, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, I saw Li'l Bro and the others at school. Sounds like all their makeup work for while they were in the US has been pretty brutal.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Well, that's the deal they made. That's just how it is.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But they seem to be practicing really hard since coming back, so I'm guessing it ended up being a good experience for them.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But seeing all those incredible performances, and tens of thousands of people burning with the heat, we felt it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This is what it means to stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But I want to learn as much as I can.
I want to take this experience and use it to make my dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Li'l Bro's doing what he can to make his dream come true too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Everyone seems to be running straight towards the things they want to do, including Li'l Bro.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You too, Enanan! You've been working super hard in art class and stuff in order to get into art school, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Wait, where'd this coming from? You're not going to sweet-talk me.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, come on, I really mean it!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Because I don't really have a clear idea of what I wanna do in the future, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, that's fine, isn't it? If you don't know, you don't know.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I'm not brushing you off or anything.
You might not know now, but I'm sure you'll figure it out sooner or later.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <When you put your mind to something, you usually succeed.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<You have talent, style...
And you're good at just about everything you do.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hmm♪
I never realized you felt that way about me, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Geez, now you're being a pest...
Scratch what I just said.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, I have to go to school...
See you later tonight.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You might not know now, but I'm sure you'll figure it out sooner or later.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When's that? I've never really thought about dreams and goals before now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just keep thinking about having fun in the present...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I have lots of things that I like to do.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Like watching anime, altering clothes...
And I love making videos with N25.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't have that one true passion that I really wanna pursue like Ena and the others do...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Oh, but... There might be one thing.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If I think of it as something I'd want to be in the future...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Hmm... But it's totally different from the sorts of dreams that the others are pursuing.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Mizuki!
Thank you for coming all this way. You're a lifesaver.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
Whew, look at all this luggage. I'm glad I came.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
*Wince*
I worked really hard to cut it down this far.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, you say that with four suitcases?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Wow.
I'd never pull off those kinds of flashy-colored shirts and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
But I kinda envy them.
I mean, they look so chic.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are those people over there your coworkers, Sis?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
That's right.
They've been aching to meet you, Mizuki, so I'll be sure to introduce you to them later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You will?
Hehe. I can't wait...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They're all so fashionable. I can hardly look away.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Their clothes and accessories are so unique... You can tell that they're world-class designers!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But there's more to it than just that...
Something else that makes them so dazzling.)

Wow, you look so much like Yuki!
I'm so glad to finally meet you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Calm down, Rina.
You're scaring Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Rina
rows.Line: Oh, sorry! I just couldn't wait any longer.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Honestly... Anyway, Mizuki, let me introduce you. This is Rina. She's one of the designers I work with.

rows.Speaker: Rina
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you!
I've wanted to meet you forever, since Yuki's always bragging about how cute you are!

rows.Speaker: Rina
rows.Line: She also said you really have an eye for fashion... And she was right!

rows.Speaker: Rina
rows.Line: That outfit looks so amazing on you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I really appreciate you saying that!
I really went all-out with one of my favorites today♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Your outfit's also really cute, Rina...!
Did you design it yourself?

rows.Speaker: Rina
rows.Line: I did! It's a little different from what our brand has to offer, but this is the style that I like to wear.

rows.Speaker: Rina
rows.Line: There really is nothing better than wearing your favorite clothes, am I right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Our designers are all like this. Our personal preferences are all over the place too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (All of them treasure their own likes...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Maybe that's why I was sorta starstruck.)

rows.Speaker: Rina
rows.Line: At the pop-up store we're running this time around, we're gonna be selling some of the clothes Yuki designed.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Haha. I wanted to surprise you.
So, drop by if you get a chance!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Now I really can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nice, that was quicker than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
All thanks to you.
I appreciate you lending a hand.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
I have so many things that I want to give you. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Here's an assortment of snacks from over my way! Be sure to share the fruit candy with your friends, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
There's also... These cookies!
The tin they come in is so cute, I just had to buy them. I thought you'd like them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow!
It looks like it's covered in shiny gemstones! This is so cute...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I'm thinking about giving Mom and Dad these cat decorations. Aren't they cute?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Talk about funny poses! Are they doing handstands?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Speaking of them, they're really happy about you coming back, Sis. They were even heralding your “triumphant return home”!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Oh, they always blow things out of proportion.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But you're really doing amazing, though! Your clothes are gonna be sold in an actual store!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I know...
But I feel like I still have a lot to learn. I mean...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: My dream is to start my own brand and have it expand to Japan. That means I have to keep growing as a designer!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, no. It's nothing big.
It's just...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Lately, I keep being reminded how amazing everyone is.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Nod*
This is about some kids I know...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They're all chasing after their dreams, training in different places, aiming to stand on top of the world with their music... Facing their art head-on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And you've always been just like them, Sis.
You're working super hard towards making your dream come true, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why I think you guys are all really amazing. Because I don't really have a dream.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What made you want to become a designer?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You told me how I was the reason why you wanted to make others smile by making clothes for them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But how did that become your dream?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I think it's because I realized those were my happiest moments.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
*Nod*
In my case, it's not like it was my dream from the very start. It's just...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: When I saw my clothes giving someone the push they needed... I felt this indescribable feeling welling up inside me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I realized... This is what true happiness must feel like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't know what the happiness she felt in those moments was like for her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But those moments must have a special place in her heart.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So special that she made them into the dream she wants to make come true, no matter what.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's see...
Where are Miku and the others?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I hope they like the souvenirs Sis brought back.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They're snacks you don't see very often, so hopefully even KAITO and the others will be interested too.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know!
I should invite Miku and them to check out the pop-up store with me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really wanna show them the clothes Sis designed.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: When I saw my clothes giving someone the push they needed... I felt this indescribable feeling welling up inside me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I realized... This is what true happiness must feel like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Len, there you are!
I was just looking for you guys.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Your mind seemed elsewhere just now...
Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But I'm totally fine.
I was just thinking about something.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I was just thinking about what I'm gonna do with myself moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, my dreams and future and stuff! For example...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Standing on top of the world as a legendary singer, or becoming a world-class musical actor!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you have any dreams like that, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I don't have a big concrete dream like that right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I do feel like I sorta would like to become a certain kind of person...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Umm... Can you tell me more about that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Well...
I don't really know how to put it into words...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I think it has to do with liking what we like or wanting to be a certain way, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I kinda want to become someone who can help people keep those precious feelings of theirs safe. Something like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just want to keep being me forever...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But fighting to stay me, I've had to endure...a lot of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sometimes I even thought it'd be easier if I just gave up on everything I care about.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sis and everyone from N25 told me that it's okay for me to just be myself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Little by little, I even started believing them. And now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now, I can just be myself.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Everyone around you helped you stay true to your own feelings.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's why I feel like it's my turn now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to become someone like them, who can help others stay true to their feelings.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, I still don't have a solid idea of what I actually want to do with myself.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And I'll cheer you on, while you become who you want to be.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Ena. You here to take a break?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I reached a good place to stop with my assignment for art class, so I decided to pop over.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, what's with the bags?
They're huge.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I totally forgot!
I came over to share these souvenirs with you guys!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh right, your big sister is back at home now, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, since yesterday morning.
She brought back a ton of snacks and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna give all of these to Miku and the others later, but... Since you're here now, wanna sneak a few?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I've got fruit candy, cookies... Oh, and real macarons!
And that's not even all of it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which would you like to try, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, I wanna try some of these chocolate sticks...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: These are from a chocolatier that my sis really recommends. So, bon appetit!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad you like them so much!
I'm gonna have some of these cookies♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, I'll have one of these macarons.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Snacks always taste better when we eat them together.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Being a designer, your sister's got some really good taste. I mean, this gift wrap's so cute.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Speaking of, your sister works for Fleur Libre, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kinda. I saw some of their stuff on social media a while back, and the designs were pretty sharp and appealing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, if you're interested, then wanna come check out the pop-up store with me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Of course!
I was actually thinking about inviting everyone.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm... Yeah.
I do wanna see what it's like, so maybe I will.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then, we're all set!
I'll ask Kanade and Mafuyu later tonight♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's see... I think it's past that shop!
Hurry, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Seriously, Mizuki, you're being way too hyper.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! I'm just so happy about finally getting to introduce all of N25 to her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I can't wait to check out the shop with everyone too!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I wonder what it'll be like.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Isn't that it right there? The one with the “Fleur Libre” sign.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, this is what it's like.
It looks really trendy, and a lot seems to have gone into the displays.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it's hard not to get even more excited...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki, isn't that your sister over there?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Looks like she's busy with a customer right now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wanna browse around while we wait?
I'm already seeing a few things that I like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's do that!
I'm gonna look for the perfect clothes for all of you♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aww... Don't be so bashful.
Just bear with me for a bit!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Look, Mafuyu, check out this blouse—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry... I didn't mean to bump into you...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Sorry about that.
I'm just so excited...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I wonder what happened to that person.
She seemed to be feeling kinda down...)

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: No, even if I were to wear something like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Mizuki, everyone! Sorry for making you all wait!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Thanks for coming to visit today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Kanade, Mafuyu, it's been ages. Since that last meetup, right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's nice to see you again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I'm so glad to see you. We didn't get much chance to talk last time.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Before I forget, thank you for using those scrunchies. Mizuki sent me pictures of all of you wearing them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, no, thank you.
We really appreciate you making them for us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Hehe. They looked so good on all of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I heard that your entire group is here today.
Which means...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you.
I'm our group's illustrator, Ena Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Yes, I had a feeling that you were Ena!
It's so great to finally meet you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Mizuki's always telling me stories about all of you, so I've always wanted to know what you were like!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
And now I finally get to meet you!
Thank you for always looking after Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Sis, calm down.
You're practically bowling her over.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
I didn't mean to be so in your face like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
But I am genuinely happy.
I mean, I've heard so much about you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Really...thank you for being Mizuki's friend.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Not at all. I actually owe Mizuki quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa, you guys are making me blush like crazy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Haha. It feels a bit like Parents' Day at school... Or maybe more like a parent-teacher conference?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: But... I really am happy about finally meeting one of Mizuki's dearest friends.

rows.Speaker: Rina's Voice
rows.Line:
Yuki!
Sorry to interrupt, but can you do an inventory check for me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Oh, sure!
Okay, everyone, feel free to look around as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's really clear that she's your big sister, Mizuki.
<Yes, she seems like such a kind and cheerful person.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah. Umm... Is it safe right now...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The coast is clear!
No other customers are around at the moment.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, Mizuki, this is your big sister's store?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I've never seen some of these clothing designs before.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You guys all seem really interested.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, now that Miku and the others are all here, let's have a good browse!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Umm... Some of the clothes your sister designed are also here, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are we gonna be able to tell that she was the one who designed them? They're probably gonna be mixed in with clothes by other designers, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm... Maybe.
And this store's pretty big, so finding her clothes might be challenging.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll try asking her later, and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a bit of a bold design, but there's also this gentleness to it... I sorta feel like trying it on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's a little different from what she used to make, but it's pretty close to a dress she made for me once.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: No, even if I were to wear something like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Wait a second...
Is she looking at this dress...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What do you think is going on with her?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Maybe she's interested in the dress that your sister designed?>

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: No, even if I were to wear something like this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There might be more to it than just that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are you interested in that dress over there? I'm sorry about us clumping up around it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We were just talking about how cute it is... But we're done looking at it now, so it's all yours!

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: I'm happy just looking at it from over here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Her eyes... They sorta remind me of...)
If you'd like, you could try it on?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for butting in.
But if you're interested in this dress, I'd be happy to help you.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line:
But...
There's no way it would look good on me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: This is actually a very personal matter...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Because I'm the one who actually designed this dress. And I'd love it if it was picked up by someone who loves cute things.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, if you do find this dress to be cute, then just seeing you try it on would put a big smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I knew it. She was the one who designed it.)

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: Then, would it be alright if I tried it on...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
The fitting rooms are right this way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm so glad that she decided to try it on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Mizuki... Thanks for what you did back there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: That customer's actually come by a few times before. But she's always seemed hesitant to actually try anything on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: We've been worried that asking if she needs anything might just pile even more pressure on her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: If you hadn't spoken up, I would never have gotten the chance to talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm sure she has her reasons...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: But I hope she likes it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Yes, how can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Female Customer's Voice
rows.Line:
Umm, so...
It's a very cute dress, and I don't have any particular problems with it, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: If you'd like, would you like to have a look at yourself in the mirror out here? I have shoes that go with that dress too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: The big mirror is right this way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Hehe. It suits you very well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Yes, as the designer, I couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: Yes. This is such a new look for me that I really can't tell if this suits me or not.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: But I've always wanted to wear something like this.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: I feel like I finally understand that about myself.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: Yes, I do. I've always adored them.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: But ever since I was little, I've never owned any clothes that I would call cute.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: I never thought they would suit me... Even the people around me kept telling me how I'm the cool type.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: As a result, I've never really been able to come out and say that I like cute things.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: I did work up the courage one time and try on a cute dress similar to this one.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: But my friends said that it didn't suit me, and even asked, “What's gotten into you?”

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: I know they weren't trying to be mean or anything. But even so... It sort of broke my heart.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: Ever since, I've avoided clothes like this. I tell myself it'd only be a waste.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That explains why her eyes looked the way they did.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She couldn't wear the clothes she wanted, and had to suppress her desire to just be herself...)

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line:
This dress was just so cute...
I couldn't get it out of my head because I kept wondering how I'd look in it.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: I ended up coming so many times...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'm glad you decided to stop by today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I'm very happy that I was able to see you wearing that dress.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: If you wish to wear cute clothes in your heart of hearts...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Then I'd like for you to cherish that feeling.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line:
I love cute clothes, and I want to wear them.
I don't want to lie to myself anymore.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line:
So, thank you very much...
You've helped me realize something I want to cherish about myself.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: I love cute things. And cute clothes...

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: And this dress. I absolutely adore it...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: When I saw my clothes giving someone the push they needed... I felt this indescribable feeling welling up inside me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I realized... This is what true happiness must feel like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This must be one of those moments.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your sister's such an amazing person...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I also wanna be able to do this someday.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Let's see...
<Thanks for today. See you all later on Nightcord!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay, it's sent♪
I'm so glad that Ena and the others enjoyed the pop-up store!

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line:
So, thank you very much...
You've helped me realize something I want to cherish about myself.

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: I love cute things. And cute clothes...

rows.Speaker: Female Customer
rows.Line: And this dress. I absolutely adore it...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She was able to stay true to her feelings.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister's Voice
rows.Line: Mizuki, can we talk for a second?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Sorry, I know this is sudden.
But I finally finished this, and I couldn't wait to give it to you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: This. It's a gift for you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Yeah.
My original plan was to give it to you right when we met...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: But I ended up having some last adjustments to do, so it got put off.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I had no idea...
Thanks! I don't know what to say!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh?
This dress kinda looks like the one we saw in the store earlier today...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Hehe. You noticed? I actually sort of based this dress off of that one, but with a few extra additions. I figured that you'd like it more this way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, this is right up my alley!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, can I try it on?
I really wanna have you see me wearing it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Of course! I can't wait to see either.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, just gimme one sec!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I love how this bow on the side accents it♪ Plus, these little frills on the sleeves are super cute...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You really do make the best clothes in the world, Sis!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Thanks!
But to me, you look like the best person in the world for wearing it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Sis's clothes really feel like a gentle hand on the back...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They tell me that it's okay for me to be myself.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And that customer probably feels the same way.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For this dress. But not just that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We talked about this just the other day...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: About how I don't really know what my dream is.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks to you, I think I've come a little bit closer to seeing it today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I see... Can you tell me more?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think it's really hard for people to just be themselves, to like what they really like... And stay true to their feelings.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That includes me, and that customer from earlier... I have a feeling that there are a lot of people out there who are suffering the same way as us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So... I want to help them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've gotten so much help and support from my family, from my group, from others... And I want to help others just like that too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I think that suits you perfectly, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've been thinking about this for a really long time, but I was never able to get a clear image in my head...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But after going to your store today, Sis, it hit me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Clothes possess that sort of power.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, that lady looked so happy wearing your dress.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, if I can make clothes like yours... Then I might be able to pursue that option in the future.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This desire to help other people, and the fact that clothes are how I can do that... I have you and the others to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: No matter what you choose to do in life, Mizuki, you'll always have my support.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I still don't really know exactly what I wanna do...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I'll continue cherishing the present that they've given me as I walk this path.)
